name: Charge Limit
description: Keeps the battery of a kiosk that never leaves its charger between two levels, so it does not swell. Stops charging at the upper level and starts again at the lower one through the kernel's charging switch. Needs Shizuku running as root. The limits are also Home Assistant selects.
author: syphernl

settings.title: Limit charging
settings.description: Off lets the battery charge normally again. Turn it off before you remove the plugin, so charging does not stay stopped.

settings.title: Resume charging at
settings.description: Must stay below Stop charging at. A higher value moves the other one up.
